name: Pixel Trail Cursor
description: A WebGL cursor trail for React: moving the mouse stirs a velocity field that is drawn as a grid of tiny dots, each cell lighting up to seven of them by how hard the cursor moved there, so a quick sweep leaves a dense, dithered streak that thins and breaks up as it fades. Raw WebGL2, no dependencies, renders only while the trail is alive.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Grid cell in CSS px; each cell holds a 4×4 pattern of dots.

props.name: radius
props.description: Width of the stroke under the cursor, as a share of the height.

props.name: strength
props.description: How much each mouse move adds (higher = denser trail from slower moves).

props.name: persistence
props.description: How slowly the trail fades (higher = longer trail).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
